items.source: Apply this contribution to the given BeanFactoryInitializationCode.
items.translation: 将此贡献应用于给定的BeanFactoryInitializationCode。

items.source: Note: Beans implementing this interface will not have registration methods generated during AOT processing unless they also implement BeanRegistrationExcludeFilter.
items.translation: 注意：除非这些 Bean 还实现了BeanRegistrationExcludeFilter，否则在 AOT 处理期间不会为实现了此接口的 Bean 生成注册方法。
generationContext - 当前激活的生成上下文

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
